threads.body: get_lower_bound() parses spec.version via packaging.version.Version without handling invalid-but-present version strings like "1.0b0.dev" (used in multiple package pyprojects for opentelemetry-util-genai). packaging treats a dev release as ".devN" (digits required), so this will raise and crash the oldest-deps-check workflow rather than reporting mismatches.

threads.body: Editable requirements parsing treats the entire "-e" argument as a filesystem path. This breaks for editable installs with extras (e.g. "-e instrumentation/... [instruments]") because "[instruments]" becomes part of the path, so the script can't resolve the target pyproject.toml and loses the ability to match editable workspace deps by package name.
